2.0.1.name: Circulate
2.0.1.author: Anis Dadou
2.0.1.description: An open source VST3 phase smearing audio effect based on a bank of 64 allpass filters. With sample accurate parameters / modulation
2.0.1.changes:
v2: Resizable UI (right click > UI Zoom, saved per-preset), can now set Hz by
clicking and typing a value, fixed Ableton UI bug with Hz/Semitone switch,
fixed strange bounce-to-audio behavior in some DAWs, and under-the-hood
improvements to channel handling, denormal handling, and parameter sample
accuracy.
